page_title: Fluent – AI Assistant for Every Mac App

sources.entry: Fluent - AI assistant that works across apps with model and context integration.

summary.name: Fluent
summary.one_liner: Fluent is a native macOS AI assistant that works across apps via a Smart Panel (⌥Space), supporting many AI models, MCP integrations, on-device memory, and multi-model "Council" peer review.
use_cases: Fix grammar and polish drafts in any text field
Draft email and chat replies from a thread
Sort and organize files in Finder with AI
Compare web pages or options side by side
Schedule daily briefs and automations on the Mac
Chat with local models offline for privacy
summary.what_it_does:
Fluent is a macOS app that runs an AI assistant in a Smart Panel summoned with ⌥Space from any app. It captures context such as selected text, clipboard, tabs, files or the open folder, and can run customizable actions such as grammar fixing or reply drafting. It connects to AI providers via sign-in with existing ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot plans, API keys, or local models like Apple Intelligence, MLX, Ollama and LM Studio. It includes 16 built-in integrations (Finder, Calendar, Reminders, Notes, etc.), MCP server support, on-device memory (RAG) and document/picture chat, plus a Council feature where several models answer and review each other. The page also describes Computer Use, where the app operates other apps with its own pointer, and scheduled actions that can wake the Mac.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">paid
notable: Smart Panel invoked with ⌥Space in any Mac app, with context capture
Council: multiple models answer, review each other blind and reach a verdict
Memory (RAG) stores preferences locally; history encrypted on disk

Cloud models require an AI plan or API keys, which may incur costs; local models run for free on the Mac
Lifetime upgrades for Basic cost $39 extra in the License Manager; after upgrade window, newer versions are not included
